fundamentals.CRITICAL_IDENTITY_NOTE: Ticker SOLS on Nasdaq is Solstice Advanced Materials, Inc. (the former Honeywell Advanced Materials division, spun off 2025-10-30) — NOT Solidion Technology, which trades under ticker STI. The 'Advanced Materials' theme fits Solstice, not Solidion (a much smaller battery-materials company). This appears to be a company-identity question worth the PM owner's direct attention; this pass researched the ticker as given (SOLS = Solstice) and did not research Solidion/STI separately.
